== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* Is a dual citizen of Sweden and Turkey.
* He was born and raised in Sweden, but his Turkish roots are from [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bolu Bolu].
* His ID '''Bolulu''' means "someone from Bolu."
* He and his team got a void theme while he was playing in a tournament themed Runeterra regions in Italy. There was no void-themed character he played at that time and he decided to play [https://lol.fandom.com/wiki/Vel%27Koz Vel'Koz]. He says "that day I fell in love with Vel'Koz".
* He loves to play [https://lol.fandom.com/wiki/Azir Azir] but thinks Azir is weak for solo queue.
* He is close friends with [[Armut]] and [[Japone]] and they have a group called "Unraidable Raiders".
* He plays [https://lol.fandom.com/wiki/Zoe Zoe] so well that [https://lol.fandom.com/wiki/Turkish_Championship_League TCL] has a special term for him which is "Bolulu's Zoe".
* Has a brother who plays soccer professionaly in Turkey
* According to a competition video posted by [https://lol.fandom.com/wiki/Closer_(Can_%C3%87elik) Closer] in September 2019: Prefers dogs to cats, uses flash on F, prefers Faker to Rookie, says he would prefer jungle if he didn't play mid lane
